items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: Dickie gave the band a lot of drive, a lot of pure, good horn

ctx.x: I think I played pretty hard on the tenors, I leaned kind of heavy on them that way, you know. I think on some of the recordings, I mean the men sort of listened to these tenor solos, along with people like Buck and Dickie Wells and stuff, you know.
Okay. You wanted full brass, but the tenor is still the key instrument.
